description:
This is a Request for Proposals (RFP) for commercial products and/or commercial services prepared in accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Part 12,  Acquisition of Commercial Products and Commercial Services , using the competitive acquisition procedures of FAR Part 15,  Contracting by Negotiation , as supplemented by the information included in this solicitation and applicable Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) guidance. 

 This solicitation document and the incorporated provisions and clauses are those in effect through Federal Acquisition Circular (FAC) 2026-01, including applicable FAR deviations, class deviations, and RFO-related guidance in effect on the date of solicitation issuance. In the event of a conflict between this solicitation and an applicable statute, regulation, FAR deviation, or agency policy implementing the RFO, the controlling authority shall govern. 

  Uniform Contract Format:  In accordance with RFO FAR 15.109,  Uniform Contract Format , this solicitation is organized using the uniform contract format. For the complete solicitation, including all Parts, Sections, provisions, clauses, attachments, and Technical Exhibits, see  RFP No. 70LGLY27RGLB00002, Full Food Services, Federal Law Enforcement Training Centers, Glynco, Georgia . 

  Questions:  Questions regarding this Request for Proposals (RFP) must be submitted in writing no later than  11:00 a.m. Eastern Time (ET), December 1, 2026 , to Robert R. Edwards, Contracting Officer, at  robert.r.edwards@fletc.dhs.gov . Questions received after this deadline will not be accepted. Telephonic inquiries will not be entertained. 

 This announcement constitutes the solicitation. Proposals are requested, and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. 

 The Government intends to award one (1) firm-fixed-price contract as a result of this solicitation. 

  Notice to Offeror(s):  Funds are not presently available for this effort. No award will be made under this solicitation until funds are available. The Government reserves the right to cancel this solicitation, in whole or in part, either before or after the proposal closing date. In the event the Government cancels this solicitation, the Government has no obligation to reimburse an offeror for costs incurred in preparing or submitting a proposal, responding to Government requests, or otherwise participating in this solicitation. 

  Competitive Award Without Negotiation:  In accordance with FAR 15.203, the Government intends to evaluate proposals and make a competitive award without holding negotiations. Offerors shall submit their best technical and price terms in their initial proposals and should not assume they will be contacted or afforded an opportunity to revise their proposals. 

  Evaluation of Competitive Proposals:  In accordance with FAR 15.202, proposal evaluation is an assessment of each proposal and the offeror’s ability to successfully perform the prospective contract. The Government will evaluate each competitive proposal solely on the evaluation factors and subfactors stated in this RFP. 

 The Government will evaluate each proposal to determine whether the offeror demonstrates a complete understanding of the requirements described in the Performance Work Statement (PWS) and applicable Technical Exhibits (TEs), and whether the offeror has the capability and resources necessary to successfully perform all required tasks. A complete price proposal is required. Proposals that fail to comply with the submission instructions or other material requirements of this RFP may be eliminated from further consideration. 

  Clarifications:  The Government reserves the right to request clarifications from one or more offerors, as necessary, in accordance with applicable FAR requirements and RFO guidance. Clarifications may be requested to resolve minor or clerical matters or to clarify certain aspects of a proposal. Seeking clarification from one offeror does not require the Government to seek clarification from another offeror. Clarifications do not constitute negotiations. 

 In accordance with applicable regulations and RFO-related requirements, offerors must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) at the time an offer is submitted and must maintain an active registration throughout the period of performance. SAM registration information is available at  www.sam.gov . Offerors that do not have an active SAM registration, as required, may be determined ineligible for award. 

  Randolph-Sheppard Act Priority:  This acquisition is subject to the Randolph-Sheppard Act, 20 U.S.C. 107 et seq., and is competed under 34 CFR 395.33(b). The cognizant State Licensing Agency is invited to submit a proposal and will be evaluated under Factors 1, 2, and 3 on the same basis as every other offeror. 

 If the State Licensing Agency submits a proposal determined to be within the competitive range under those factors, the State Licensing Agency will be afforded priority for award in accordance with 34 CFR 395.33(b), following any consultation with the Secretary of Education required by 34 CFR 395.33(c). 

 The priority is applied after the evaluation described in this solicitation, not in place of it, and does not excuse the State Licensing Agency from any solicitation submission requirement. 

 By accepting an award, the contractor certifies compliance with FAR 52.222-50,  Combating Trafficking in Persons , including the requirement to notify employees and subcontractors at all tiers of the Federal Government’s policy prohibiting trafficking-related activities. 

  Postaward Debriefing:  In accordance with FAR 15.301-1, the awardee and offerors that receive a notice of contract award may request a postaward debriefing after receiving the notice of award. Requests for a debriefing shall be submitted in writing to the Contracting Officer in accordance with the timeframes and procedures stated in this solicitation and applicable FAR
